name: Aozora Nio
source:
Occupation: Unknown

Subject: Science

Personality: Friendly but capricious, and mysterious. She is the eighth daughter of the Aozora sisters and a nekomimi. She acts and speaks like a cat, and her hobby is clawing. She gets angry if you treat her like a cat, She has a special cat punch.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/katei/cha/nio01.html]official site[/url]]
